The [[University College Dublin]] '''Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation''' (UCD '''CCI''') is a centre for research and education in [[Computer security|cybersecurity]], [[Computer crime|cybercrime]] and [[digital forensics|digital forensic science]] in [[Dublin]], [[Ireland]].<ref name=":0" />

The UCD Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation was established in 2006,<ref>{{cite web|title=About UCD CCI|url=https://www.ucd.ie/cci/about/|publisher=UCD|accessdate=23 July 2024}}</ref> and has developed collaborative relationships with law enforcement and industry from across the world. The Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation is widely regarded{{By whom|date=July 2021}} as Europe's leading centre for research and education in cybersecurity, cybercrime and digital forensics. UCD CCI trains specialist officers from the Irish national police service, the [[Garda Síochána]], Irish military personnel from the [[Defence Forces (Ireland)|Defence Forces]], as well as international law enforcement agencies [[Interpol]] and [[Europol]], and authorities from over 40 countries.<ref name=":0">{{cite web|title=About CCI|url=http://www.ucd.ie/cci/about_cci.html|publisher=Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation, University College Dublin|accessdate=19 September 2015}}</ref> The CCI also runs educational qualifications and training for the industry sector and [[multinational corporation]]s.<ref>{{cite web|title=Masters Degree in Forensic Computing and Cybercrime Investigation at UCD|url=http://www.garda.ie/Controller.aspx?Page=7973|publisher=Garda Síochána|accessdate=19 September 2015|archive-date=28 September 2015|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150928230148/http://www.garda.ie/Controller.aspx?Page=7973|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref name="a1">{{cite web|title=Welcome message from Professor Joe There is a Memorandum of Understanding between the Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation at UCD and the [[National Cyber Security Centre (Ireland)|National Cyber Security Centre]] (NCSC) at the [[Department of Communications, Climate Action and Environment|DCCAE]], the Irish government's computer emergency response team.<ref>{{cite web|title=Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation, University College Dublin|url=http://www.ucd.ie/cci/|publisher=UCD|accessdate=8 July 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Smith|first1=Gordon|title=Cyber security a safe bet for growth|url=http://www.irishtimes.com/business/technology/cyber-security-a-safe-bet-for-growth-1.1279774|accessdate=8 July 2015|publisher=The Irish Times|date=28 January 2011}}</ref> Additionally, UCD CCI has formal relationships with the Garda Síochána, Irish Defence Forces, INTERPOL, Europol, [[Visa Inc.]], the [[Irish Banking Federation]], as well as collaborations with the [[United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime]] (UNODC), the [[Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe]] (OSCE), [[European Anti-fraud Office|European Anti-Fraud Office]] (OLAF), [[Microsoft]], [[Citibank]] and [[eBay]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Projects|url=http://www.ucd.ie/cci/projects.html|publisher=Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation, University College Dublin|accessdate=19 September 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Connolly|first1=Phillip|title=UCD to lead EU cybercrime project|url=http://www.businesspost.ie/#!story/Home/News/UCD+to+lead+EU+cybercrime+project/id/19410615-5218-5064-3d5b-c15900868938|accessdate=19 September 2015|publisher=The Sunday Business Post|date=27 September 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=Current Projects|url=http://www.ucd.ie/cci/projects/current_projects.html|publisher=Centre for Cybersecurity & Cybercrime Investigation,
